scripts.verify: bun run verify:js && bun run verify:rust && bun run verify:behavior && bun run verify:captures
scripts.verify:js: bun run check && bun run test && bun run packages:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts --dry-run && bun run gen:check
scripts.verify:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace --all-targets && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-targets
scripts.test: bun --conditions=browser --conditions=wabou-source test packages apps/*/ui scripts && vitest run && bun --conditions=browser --conditions=development --conditions=wabou-source test packages/core/src/renderer/hmr.test.ts
scripts.test:layout: cargo build --release -p wabou-cli && bun --conditions=wabou-source run apps/gallery/tests/layout.ts
scripts.packages:check: bun run scripts/check-package-boundaries.ts && tsc -p tests/package-consumer/tsconfig.json && bun run scripts/check-ui-tarball.ts
scripts.release-packages: bun run packages:build && bun run packages:check && bun run scripts/publish-packages.ts
scripts.gen:source: bun run gen:i18n && bun --conditions=wabou-source run scripts/codegen/index.ts
scripts.gen: bun run gen:source && bun run packages:build
scripts.gen:check: bun run scripts/check-generated.ts && bun run scripts/check-rust-bindings.ts
scripts.build: bun run gen && bun run wabou build apps/gallery
